from qiskit import QuantumCircuit
from qiskit.circuit.library import RYGate, iSwapGate, CUGate, RXGate, RCCXGate, HGate, RXXGate, MCXGate, SXdgGate, ZGate, C3SXGate
from qiskit.compiler import transpile
from qiskit_aer import AerSimulator

# Construct a quant circuit labeled circ with 9 qubits & 2 classical bits
circ = QuantumCircuit(9, 2)

# RYGate to qubit 8, theta=0.5
circ.append(RYGate(0.5), [8])

# iSwap gate between qubits 0 and 5
circ.append(iSwapGate(), [0, 5])

# Controlled-u gate between qubits 0 and 4 (theta=0.5, phi=1, lam=0, gamma=1.5)
# Note: CUGate(theta, phi, lam, gamma)
circ.append(CUGate(0.5, 1, 0, 1.5), [0, 4])

# RXGate to qubit 1, theta=0
circ.append(RXGate(0), [1])

# Simplified toffoli (Margolus) gate between qubits 0, 4 and 5
circ.append(RCCXGate(), [0, 4, 5])

# HGate to qubit 2
circ.append(HGate(), [2])

# RXXGate between qubits 4 and 6, theta=1.5
circ.append(RXXGate(1.5), [4, 6])

# General multi-controlled x gate between qubits 4 and 6, num_ctrl_qubits=1
# Since it is between 4 and 6 with 1 control, qubit 4 is control, 6 is target
circ.append(MCXGate(1), [4, 6])

# Inverse single-qubit sqrt(x) gate to qubit 1
circ.append(SXdgGate(), [1])

# ZGate to qubit 3
circ.append(ZGate(), [3])

# 3-qubit controlled sqrt-x gate between qubits 1, 3, 7 and 8
# Controls: 1, 3, 7; Target: 8
circ.append(C3SXGate(), [1, 3, 7, 8])

# Transpile the circuit using AerSimulator backend with optimization level 1
backend = AerSimulator()
isa_circuit = transpile(circ, backend=backend, optimization_level=1)
